questions.prompt: In Michaelis-Menten enzyme kinetics, what does the constant Km represent?
options: The maximum rate of the reaction (Vmax)
The substrate concentration at which the reaction velocity is half of Vmax
questions.explanation: Km is the substrate concentration at which the reaction reaches 1/2 Vmax; a lower Km indicates higher substrate affinity.

questions.prompt: What is the rate-limiting regulatory enzyme of glycolysis?
questions.explanation: PFK-1 catalyzes the committed phosphorylation of Fructose-6-phosphate to Fructose-1,6-bisphosphate.
